INPUT = "( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ]"
SUBMITTED = "( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ] ) ] ) ]"

CLOSER_TO_OPENER = {")": "(", "]": "[", "}": "{", ">": "<"}
OPENER_TO_CLOSER = {v: k for k, v in CLOSER_TO_OPENER.items()}


def scan(tokens):
    """Return (remaining_stack, error). error is None when every closer matches."""
    stack = []
    for i, tok in enumerate(tokens):
        if tok in OPENER_TO_CLOSER:
            stack.append(tok)
        elif tok in CLOSER_TO_OPENER:
            if not stack:
                return stack, ("unmatched closer", i, tok)
            if stack[-1] != CLOSER_TO_OPENER[tok]:
                return stack, ("mismatched closer", i, tok, stack[-1])
            stack.pop()
        else:
            return stack, ("unknown token", i, tok)
    return stack, None


in_tokens = INPUT.split()

in_stack, in_err = scan(in_tokens)

print("CHECK PASS" if valid else "CHECK FAIL")
